alerts.name: Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments
alerts.desc: The response appears to contain suspicious comments which may help an attacker. Note: Matches must be made against the entire response, this may involve the response being chunked and processed when a page load is simulated. This is not the same as matching against the response in the network pane of the browser, or the response in the ZAP history tab.
alerts.solution: Remove all comments that return information that may help an attacker and fix any underlying problems they refer to.
